description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy in different scenarios, specifically testing its handling of placeholders in policies and access control lists within the context of modifying 'things' in the system.

classes.name: ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: Test class for Verify behavior of ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy regarding placeholders in policies and ACLs.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that when no placeholder is present in policy subject IDs, the same command instance is returned.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that when no inline policy is provided, the original command instance is returned.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenInvalidInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that invalid inline policies do not alter the command instance.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies substitution occurs correctly when a placeholder for policy subject ID is present.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForAclSubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies substitution occurs correctly within access control list entries when placeholders are present.
